title: USS Finch cigar-shaped object shot down near Johnston Island

tellings.quote: guys and they're all talking about the bogey that was seemed to be shot out of the sky

plain: In 1962, near Johnston Island in the Pacific, sailors aboard the Navy ship USS Finch are said to have watched a cigar-shaped object that seemed to be shot out of the sky. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells Michels this, passing on the account of a man named David Noble White Horse, who describes the crew all talking about the 'bogey', an unidentified target, that went down. If true, it would be an early case of the military bringing down an unknown craft.
